direction.main: DF-internal speaker-disjoint nested 5 outer x 3 inner CV; not T->DF transfer
direction.selection: inner OOF balanced logloss, smallest C on ties
direction.scalar: train-fold quantile cubic spline(s), log(norm_z), direction_valid
direction.noise: ID-stable seed601 Gaussian unit vectors projected perpendicular to c; dimension160
direction.fit_scope: all preprocessing, C selection and classifier fitting exclude each outer held speaker

matching.order: SHA256 bona ID then nearest caliper-scaled distance, stable spoof ID ties
matching.extra: same source x codec x speaker using primary calipers
matching.use: descriptive direction comparison; evaluate already-held-out CV predictions on matched rows
matching.not_claimed: exact conditional independence test or population performance

channel.ranking: T-only attack-macro Fisher(z), same as earlier ranking
channel.score: cosine(mask*z, mask*c), re-normalize both; no probe refit
channel.main: drop40 vs native and random drop40 distribution

LayerNorm.main: scalar+h vs scalar+z, identical 160 appended features and nested L2 grid
LayerNorm.meaning: readability under these probes, not information-theoretic loss

conditions.clusters: spherical kmeans K4; T balanced2500/class; 5 starts501..505, choose T objective

uncertainty.group: source-prefixed speaker; original utterance families unresolved
uncertainty.CI: individual95%; family99% for five primary comparisons
uncertainty.CV_limit: bootstrap conditions on saved OOF predictions, not full nested model refits
uncertainty.random_mask_spread: design variability; not a sampling confidence interval

limits: linear probes do not exhaust information
channel intervention is at embedding level, not an acoustic causal intervention
